mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the federal funds rate over the prior month signals active monetary easing, reducing discount rates applied to equity valuations and producing positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 60% of instances where FEDFUNDS declines over the prior month, or the Rank IC over 3-year rolling windows remains below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A rise in the unemployment rate exceeding 0.3 percentage points over the prior three months signals deteriorating labor market conditions, reducing consumer spending capacity and generating negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 60% of instances where UNRATE rises > 0.3pp in 3 months, or the Rank IC over 3-year rolling windows falls below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous decline in housing starts (HOUST) and industrial production (INDPRO) exceeding 0.5% over the prior two months signals contraction in both consumer and business activity, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
candidate_trigger: HOUST and INDPRO both decline > 0.5% in 2 months
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 60% of instances where both HOUST and INDPRO decline > 0.5% in 2 months, or the Rank IC over 3-year windows remains below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: When annualized CPIAUCSL exceeds 3.5%, the market anticipates aggressive monetary tightening by the Federal Reserve, resulting in negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 60% of instances where CPIAUCSL > 3.5% annualized, or the Rank IC over 3-year rolling windows falls below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A decline in industrial production (INDPRO) exceeding 0.5% over the prior month signals manufacturing contraction, reducing corporate earnings expectations and producing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are positive in more than 60% of instances where INDPRO declines > 0.5% in 1 month, or the Rank IC over 3-year windows remains below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in residential housing starts (HOUST) exceeding 1.0% over the prior three months signals robust consumer demand, driving positive S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are negative in more than 60% of instances where HOUST rises > 1.0% in 3 months, or the Rank IC over 3-year rolling windows falls below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous increase in payroll employment (PAYEMS) exceeding 0.5% and decrease in unemployment rate (UNRATE) exceeding 0.2 percentage points over the prior two months signals strong labor market conditions, boosting consumer spending and generating positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
candidate_trigger: PAYEMS rises > 0.5% and UNRATE falls > 0.2pp in 2 months
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 60% of instances where PAYEMS rises > 0.5% and UNRATE falls > 0.2pp in 2 months, or the Rank IC over 3-year windows remains below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A rise in consumer credit (RSAFS) exceeding 0.8% over the prior two months signals increasing consumer leverage, which drives positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days in low-inflation environments.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 60% of instances where RSAFS rises > 0.8% in 2 months, or the Rank IC over 3-year rolling windows falls below 0.03.
